author: Aaron
text:
Hi Scott,

Good charting.

I have attached a few charts that may give you some things to think about, not saying they're correct though, just my 10 pips

I understand where you have marked the FTR area on the 1st chart, so I will jump to the second chart what I see, is the lowest zone is an FTR, above this is an SR flip where as you pointed out, price reacted well at this price level. I agree the next green level is a DP point to engulf, the engulf is pretty easy to see, it's above the top red line.

Something I have learnt whilst studying engulfs and I have to be honest here, it was by far the most enjoyable P.A concept to learn for me so far, is where are we engulfing in to???? If we take a look on the 4hr chart this will probably answer the question as to whether this was a decent engulf or not. The 4hr chart contains a beautiful FTR which price reacted to nicely, just after the engulf, so if we think about this logically a 4hr decent-looking zone against an hourly engulf, I will go with the 4hr zone, I would even go as far to say this was a perfect FO.

Scott, I may be wrong here buddy, but this is what I saw on your charts.

DT

Edit: I just noticed where the DP was in relation to the 4hr FTR, the 4hr level could have been a target for your DP trade, well done Scott.
